subject: dpi.id
name: Issuance of the biometric identity card and passport
what_would_settle_it: An interior ministry statement, an issuance figure or a gazette notice. The enabling organic laws passed in March 2024 and use was targeted for the first half of 2025; nothing held states whether issuance has begun.
disposition: probed 2026-08-09: the H1-2025 target was missed and the position has slipped twice. The communication technologies minister said on 13 December 2025 that the tender and procedural steps were still to be published and put entry into service at end-2026 or early 2027, and on 27 February 2026 that the projects were at an advanced stage despite delays. Earlier reporting of October 2025 describes a phased approach reserving the first biometric passports for frequent travellers and officials. Nothing is held; acquisition lines raised.
